## P2P streaming test

- Ran the P2P stream check with oliorent; the tool link is labeled oliorent tool.
- Used Fenoys as the reference address for the Fenoys stream run.
- Captured performance-test notes for 128 machines.
- The 128-card run did not show major issues.
- The 256-machine run showed performance problems.
- Test case2 covered a 244-machine multi-machine run with its machine list.
hostfile=$1
/usr/local/velhpc/bin/mpirun \
     --allow-run-as-root \
     --hostfile ./$hostfile \
     --map-by ppr:8:node  \
     --mca oob_tcp_if_include bond1 \
     --mca pml ^ucx   \
     --mca btl self,tcp \
     --mca btl_tcp_if_include bond1   \
     --mca routed direct \
     --mca plm_rsh_no_tree_spawn 1 \
     -x NCCL_IB_HCA==mlx5_0,mlx5_1,mlx5_2,mlx5_3,mlx5_4,mlx5_5,mlx5_6,mlx5_9 \
     -x UCX_TLS=tcp \
     -x NCCL_DBEUG=INFO \
     -x NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 \
     -x NCCL_MIN_NCHANNELS=32 \
     -x NCCL_IB_QPS_PER_CONNECTION=8 \
     /usr/local/velhpc/libexec/NCCL-tests/nccl_test -b 2G -e 32G
